name: Speediest Freeks
description: When your opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, target one Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army that was selected as a target. Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save, or a 4+ invulnerable save if the unit is a Vehicle with Toughness 8 or less.

name: Squig Flingin'
description: When your Movement phase, just after a Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, target that unit. Select one enemy unit within 9" of it; that enemy must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

name: Dakkastorm
description: When your Shooting phase, target one Speed Freeks unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot. Until the end of the phase, its ranged weapons have [SUSTAINED HITS 1], or [SUSTAINED HITS 2] when targeting a unit within 9".

name: Blitza Fire
description: When your Shooting phase, target one Speed Freeks unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot. Until the end of the phase, its ranged weapons have [LETHAL HITS], and attacks against a unit within 9" score Critical Hits on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

name: Full Throttle!
description: When your Charge phase, just after a Speed Freeks unit from your army ends a Charge move, target that unit. Until the end of the turn, each time a model in it makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: More Gitz Over 'Ere!
description: When your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, target one Speed Freeks unit from your army within 9" of that enemy and not within Engagement Range. It can make a Normal move of up to 6".
